name: bug-dhor
description: Explainable vulnerability analysis, counterfactual feature inspection, and verified repair for VS Code.

bugdhor.backend.url.markdownDescription: Base URL of the running Bug Dhor FastAPI backend. Use only an HTTP or HTTPS origin with no credentials, path, query, or fragment. The extension appends `/api/v1` itself.

bugdhor.backend.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for scan and analysis requests. The request is aborted and reported to the user when it expires.

bugdhor.backend.healthTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for backend health checks.

bugdhor.privacy.sendSourceText.markdownDescription: Send the active document text and selected text with explicitly user-invoked scan and analysis commands. Disable to send only file paths and ranges; the backend then reads the saved file from disk. Workspace scans never send file contents. Background monitoring also requires bugdhor.monitoring.allowAutomaticSourceSharing and never sends source text without it.

bugdhor.backend.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Reserved for a future backend process manager. The extension currently connects to an already-running backend and does not start one.

bugdhor.backend.autoStart.description: Reserved for a future backend process manager. The extension currently connects to an already-running backend and does not start one.

enumDescriptions: Show trace, debug, info, warning, and error messages.
Show debug, info, warning, and error messages.
Show info, warning, and error messages.
Disable Bug Dhor output channel messages.
bugdhor.logging.level.description: Log level for the Bug Dhor output channel.

bugdhor.ui.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the Bug Dhor status bar item.

bugdhor.monitoring.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable background monitoring of Python and JavaScript document changes. Monitoring is off by default. It observes ordinary editor changes from any source and never claims to identify an AI assistant or model.

bugdhor.monitoring.allowAutomaticSourceS.markdownDescription: Explicit consent to send changed source text for automatic background analysis. No background analysis request containing source text is sent unless this AND bugdhor.privacy.sendSourceText are enabled. Enabling this setting alone does not enable monitoring.

bugdhor.monitoring.onSaveOnly.description: Analyze only on document save instead of after debounced edits.

bugdhor.monitoring.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before a debounced background analysis runs. Rapid edits collapse into one scan of the latest document version.

bugdhor.monitoring.languages.description: Language IDs eligible for background monitoring. Python and JavaScript are supported initially.

enumDescriptions: Scope each request to the changed lines only.
Scope each request to the functions enclosing the changed lines, falling back to changed lines for top-level edits.
Scan the whole file on every monitored change.
bugdhor.monitoring.analysisScope.description: Granularity of incremental background analysis. Wide change batches fall back to a bounded file-level scan.

bugdhor.monitoring.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum document size in bytes for background analysis. Larger documents are skipped.

bugdhor.monitoring.maxChangedLines.description: Maximum number of changed lines analyzed incrementally. Wider batches fall back to a bounded file-level scan.

bugdhor.monitoring.excludeGlobs.description: Path globs excluded from background monitoring. Supports *, **, and ?.

bugdhor.monitoring.watchWorkspaceFiles.markdownDescription: Watch official workspace file create, delete, and folder-change events. Requires bugdhor.monitoring.enabled.

bugdhor.monitoring.scanNewFiles.markdownDescription: Scan eligible source files when they are created in the workspace. Opening the file for inspection is the only way content is observed; no private API is used.

bugdhor.monitoring.scanOnOpen.markdownDescription: Scan an eligible document when it is opened. Disabled by default so browsing files does not repeatedly trigger scans.

bugdhor.monitoring.fullScanOnWorkspaceCh.markdownDescription: Schedule a full metadata-only workspace scan when workspace folders are added or removed. Disabled by default because it can be expensive.

bugdhor.monitoring.fullScanDebounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before a full workspace scan runs. Repeated workspace changes collapse into one scan.

bugdhor.monitoring.maxConcurrentScans.description: Maximum number of concurrent workspace-level scans. Document-level scans remain per-document bounded.

bugdhor.monitoring.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum number of newly created files observed from one workspace event. Extra files are ignored to keep the editor responsive.

bugdhor.monitoring.excludeBinaryFiles.description: Skip files with common binary extensions before opening them for monitoring.

bugdhor.monitoring.excludeGeneratedFiles.description: Skip common generated files such as minified bundles, source maps, and lockfiles.

bugdhor.monitoring.notifyOnFindings.description: Show a non-blocking notification when a background scan publishes findings.

bugdhor.feedback.notifyOnPatchApplied.markdownDescription: Notify when Bug Dhor records an explicitly applied patch. The finding remains open until a clean rescan and passing verification are recorded.

bugdhor.feedback.notifyOnResolution.markdownDescription: Notify when a finding is resolved after a clean rescan and passing verification.

bugdhor.recommendations.runFunctionalTes.markdownDescription: Require functional tests for secure recommendations. When disabled, no candidate can be recommended.

bugdhor.recommendations.allowSandboxedEx.markdownDescription: Explicitly allow sandboxed test execution for secure recommendations. Network, privileged, and destructive operations remain forbidden.

bugdhor.recommendations.testCommand.markdownDescription: Optional argv list for project functional tests. Empty means the backend uses repository detection only.

bugdhor.recommendations.testTimeoutSecon.description: Maximum time allowed for one functional-test run during recommendation verification.

enumDescriptions: Use only documented editor change events (capability A).
Discover a model through the documented VS Code Language Model API.
Use a configured OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint.
Use a direct local Hugging Face model with explicitly injected adapters.
Use an official extension-specific API declared by a local manifest.
bugdhor.assistant.provider.markdownDescription: Selected assistant integration. Capabilities are discovered, never assumed. Internal activation, SAE, and steering capabilities remain unavailable unless explicitly validated.

bugdhor.assistant.vscodeLanguageModel.se.markdownDescription: Optional `vendor`, `family`, `id`, or `version` selector passed to the documented `vscode.lm.selectChatModels` API.

bugdhor.assistant.openAiCompatible.endpo.markdownDescription: Base URL or full `/chat/completions` URL of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Credentials in the URL are rejected.

bugdhor.assistant.openAiCompatible.model.description: Model identifier sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

bugdhor.assistant.openAiCompatible.apiKe.markdownDescription: Name of the environment variable containing the API key. Keys are never stored in extension settings or logs.

bugdhor.assistant.localHuggingFace.model.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a local Hugging Face model directory containing `config.json`. Reading metadata does not grant generation or activation access.

bugdhor.assistant.extensionApi.manifestP.markdownDescription: Path to an explicit JSON manifest describing an official extension API, its documentation URL, and its declared capabilities. Undocumented interfaces are never used.

bugdhor.assistant.sae.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable attempts to attach a validated local SAE provider. This does not claim SAE capability by itself; D and E must be discovered first.

bugdhor.assistant.counterfactual.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable attempts to attach a configured counterfactual provider. D, E, and F must be discovered first.
